scope: Exact-proposal review records, outside-scope and verification-path acknowledgements, explicit criterion observations and uncertainty; not automatic semantic proof or a new external model run.

reviewCases.name: durable implementation recovery recovers after the writing process exits mid-apply, including an outdated progress list
durable implementation recovery reconciles a partial undo but refuses to overwrite any subsequent user edit
durable implementation recovery restores review, applies, restarts again, and undoes without losing the saved design
durable implementation recovery persists explicit scope and test review, rejects stale proposals and preserves uncertainty
durable implementation recovery invalidates old approvals and checks when the agent connection is lost
durable implementation recovery invalidates a completed review if its files change after restart
durable implementation recovery persists a real failed launch and restores it without launching another process
durable implementation recovery rejects corrupt records, forged source paths, and snapshot hashes before restoring
durable implementation recovery excludes a second writer until its lease is released
durable implementation recovery excludes another process and releases the lease after its owner is killed
durable implementation recovery can acquire an IPC lease while an unrelated service holds the former TCP port
implementation review evidence compares real paths and marks test/configuration candidates without semantic claims

browser.data: Synthetic fixture and browser-local mock persistence with real product React components
checks: outside-scope and verification candidates are explicitly acknowledged
a confirmed criterion requires a note and can link a successful check log
a known failure blocks apply even when uncertainty is accepted
explicit acceptance of unknown criteria permits mock apply without relabeling them confirmed

limitations: Criterion outcomes are reviewer statements, not automatic behavior verification
Path classification does not find every custom verification file or determine test weakening
Scope acknowledgement controls original-file application, not every agent write in its worktree
Installed verification uses a deterministic stdio test fixture
Browser evidence is not installed Webview pointer/keyboard end-to-end evidence
